ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies slipped modestly on Tuesday, with BTC down 0.6% and ETH down 1.2%, reflecting a cautious tone after recent negative news. The market is further pressured by the shutdown of the Blast Ethereum L2 and workforce reductions at Anchorage Digital, while new token listings on Delta India may provide fresh trading opportunities.
